Rae (CS): Quick ask — Beacon (pilot) needs a 10m preflight card for their exec demo. They want a single-sheet checklist they can run 5–10 minutes before the call and a 2-question exec pulse. Can SRE/SE help?
Omar (SRE): I can. Short Qs: are replies streamed? expected peak concurrency? Any heavy background jobs during demo window?
ClientOps (Customer): Streaming chat, mostly short turns (~50 tokens). Expect ~35 concurrent. We have a large nightly embedding job at 03:00 UTC but can nudge it +1h.
Julian (Solutions Eng): Proposed preflight defaults (tailored for short-turn streaming):
- Prime common prefixes 10min prior (we'll include script).
- streaming.flush_ms = 30 (tighter for snappy UX).
- batching.target_tokens = 5 OR batching.max_wait_ms = 20 (whichever triggers first).
- sampling of outputs = 2% for hallucination checks (demo routes only).
- set fallback policy: gpu -> cpu-quantized (note expected latency increase ~1.6x).
Omar (SRE): Ops checklist (bite-sized):
1) Run prime script 10m before demo start.
2) Set demo route streaming.flush_ms = 30.
3) Set batching.target_tokens = 5 / max_wait_ms = 20.
4) Temporarily increase autoscale headroom +40% for window [-10m, +30m].
5) If possible, shift nightly embedding job +1h.
6) Capture Console latency tile screenshot and enable 2% sample of outputs.
Snippet: 
```
# one-click prime for demo
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prime -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rw-medium","prompts":["Hello","Open my dashboard","What changed today?"]}'
```
Pri (PM): Renewal gating idea: mark account green if 99th %ile < 210ms AND error rate < 0.3% for 3 demos (within 30 days). If fails once -> amber and schedule SE follow-up. If fails after SE fixes -> flag at-risk for renewal.
Rae (CS): Can we make a single-sheet PDF for the customer with these bullets + the exec pulse (2 questions) and a tiny expectations blurb about fallback latency? I'll send it to Beacon.
Julian (Solutions Eng): I'll add a short line about embeddings: run at off-peak, chunk to 600 vectors/batch, and add exponential retry for 429s starting at 150ms.
Omar (SRE): I'll create the infra ticket to set autoscale window and the failing-open healthcheck that serves cached stub when upstream is overloaded. Ticket link to follow.
OpsReminderBot: Reminder set: "Beacon preflight prime" at 2026-04-25T09:50:00Z (owner: Rae). :bell:

Rae (CS): Action items: Rae -> assemble PDF + pulse and share with customer; Omar -> infra ticket + autoscale; Julian -> prime link + embed guidance; Pri -> update renewal gating on account tile. Can we confirm by EOD?
